verdict.rationale: Rev AI is an API-based speech-to-text service, so issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence pack never mentions API key scoping, permissions, or per-agent credentials. The cited docs cover transcription features, webhooks, streaming, pricing and an MCP server install, none of which concern credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
